observations.action_taken: recorded and documented at the definition site; the end-to-end suite asserts the invariant that IS guaranteed — every candidate holds a whole number of leading batches and nothing after them.
observations.consequence: a retrospective per-batch elimination list is a decision, not a historical record of what the control plane knew at the time. What happened to the queue is durable in the queue.
observations.detail: race_l2f2_phase_c_batch(batch_index=k) recomputes from the whole immutable ledger, not from the ledger as it stood when batch k closed. During a campaign the two coincide, because batch k+1 is materialized before any of it is decided. Replayed against a finished confirmation, racing batch 0 sees all fifty members and eliminates candidates the live campaign carried further.
observations.title: a per-batch racing decision is evaluated against the ledger as it stands
observations.why_it_is_correct: more observation narrows the racing bounds and can never widen them, so elimination is monotone and no candidate is ever resurrected. The operational guarantee is untouched: at the moment batch k+1 was materialized, only candidates surviving through batch k received jobs.
